environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (m5.large) running Amazon Linux 2, directly exposed via an Elastic IP with security group allowing inbound TCP/8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. PostgreSQL 14 on RDS (db.t3.medium) in same VPC, connected via DATABASE_URL with a role that has SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE on all tables in the public schema. No reverse proxy or middleware in front of the Go binary.

config.database: RDS PostgreSQL 14, role: app_readwrite (SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE on public.*)
